errors.evidence: The model names on the x-axis are "Qwen2-1.5B-IT" and "Qwen2-7B-IT", but they are incorrectly transcribed in the description.

errors.text_span: with tick labels at every 10-second increment
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels are at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80), not 10.

errors.text_span: Four different bar groups are present
errors.evidence: The description states there are four bar groups, but immediately after lists six different configurations/series. There are six bars within each group on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: ARC-JSD – TyDi QA (purple), ARC-JSD – Hotpot QA (light blue), Contextcite – TyDi QA (orange), Contextcite – Hotpot QA (red), ARC-JSD - MuSiQue (light green), and Contextcite - MuSiQue (dark blue)
errors.evidence: The color mapping to the series is largely incorrect. For example, ARC-JSD - TyDi QA is dark blue (not purple), Contextcite - Hotpot QA is light orange (not red), ARC-JSD - MuSiQue is very light blue (not light green), and Contextcite - MuSiQue is very light orange (not dark blue).

errors.text_span: For the "Owen2-1.5B-IT" model, the purple bar has a value of approximately 5 seconds and the orange bar has a value of approximately 25 seconds.
errors.evidence: The model name is misspelled. For the Qwen2-1.5B-IT model, the dark blue bar (ARC-JSD - TyDi QA, described as purple) has a value of ~2, not 5. The orange bar (Contextcite - TyDi QA) has a value of ~4, not 25.

errors.text_span: for the "Gemma2-9B-IT" model, the orange bar reaches a value of around 80 seconds
errors.evidence: For the Gemma2-9B-IT model, the orange bar (Contextcite - TyDi QA) has a value of approximately 13, not 80. The bar that reaches the highest value (approx. 88) corresponds to Contextcite - MuSiQue, which is a very light orange color, not the primary orange.
